latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of RiskShield approval automation skill.

- Automates RiskShield case approval using Playwright for browser automation.
- Supports both "Pass" (with customizable credit amount) and "Refuse" (with selectable refuse code) actions.
- Automatically verifies approval results and updates case status.
- Runs in headless (background) mode without affecting other work.
- Command-line usage with parameter options for case number, operation, refuse code, and approval amount.
